# starter-spi transitive dependency baseline.
#
# Generated by:
#   LC_ALL=C cargo tree -p starter-spi --edges normal --prefix none \
#     | sed -e 's/ (\*)//' -e 's| (<workspace>/[^)]*)||' \
#     | LC_ALL=C sort -u
#
# Smoke test 1 of DOCS/tools/scope/SCOPE.md compares the live output of
# the same command against this file. Provider crates' deps (slack SDKs,
# google-apis-* etc.) MUST NOT appear here. Update this baseline ONLY
# when `starter-spi` itself changes (a new direct dep is added, an
# existing dep changes major, or a re-export pulls something new
# in) — never to silence a provider-crate leak. Decision D1.
#
# The canonical update / verify script is
# `scripts/check-spi-dep-baseline.sh`; CI runs it on every PR via the
# `spi-dep-baseline` job in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. The script
# normalises the `(*)` re-display marker, the workspace-local path on
# the `starter-spi` self-entry (so checkouts on different machines
# still match), and forces `LC_ALL=C` so sort order is byte-stable.
